scope: Prepared three-client/two-group engine checks. QA fixed BindableFunction actions clear NPCs, skip to zones3/6, reposition actual bodies, and apply the existing Session Dash hit; health/reserve values are never directly edited. Production client key/touch inputs catch food. The simultaneous race uses two scheduled valid production Attack packets from actual clients with explicit high sequences, then the test ends. This is not a natural complete level clear or a physical device test.

phone.hitMapping: Explicit MCP coordinates add emulator offsets(+62,+20); actual Punch.Activated count1 and real state transition confirm the hit.

preparationHook:
-- Test-session-only diagnostic. Not present in repository or generated place.
local qa=Instance.new('BindableFunction');qa.Name='BrickToadsFliesQA';qa.Parent=game.ServerStorage
qa.OnInvoke=function(action,groupId,slot)
 local result={}
 if action=='freeze' then
  for _,id in controller.order do
   local c=controller.groups[id].controller
   for eid,a in c.world.actors do if eid<0 then a.humanoid.Health=0 end end
  end
 elseif action=='prepare' then
  local c=assert(controller.groups[groupId]).controller
  for eid in c.director.enemies do c.director:_kill(eid) end
  c.director:_enterZone(3)
  for eid in c.director.enemies do c.director:_kill(eid) end
  for uid,a in c.world.actors do
   if uid>0 then a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(174,3,-5)+c.world.offset,Vector3.new(178,3,-5)+c.world.offset));a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero end
  end
 elseif action=='snapshot' then
  for _,id in controller.order do
   local g=controller.groups[id];local c=g.controller
   if c.current then result[id]={state=c.current:snapshot(),level=c.director:snapshot(),rows=c.director.flies.rows,logs=c.current.logs,offset={g.world.offset.X,g.world.offset.Y,g.world.offset.Z}} end
  end
 elseif action=='place' then
  local c=controller.groups[groupId].controller;local a=c.world.actors[slot]
  a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(174,3,-5)+c.world.offset,Vector3.new(178,3,-5)+c.world.offset));a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 elseif action=='secondFly' then
  local c=controller.groups[groupId].controller;local a=c.world.actors[slot]
  a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(180,3,5)+c.world.offset,Vector3.new(184,3,5)+c.world.offset));a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 elseif action=='retreat' then
  local c=controller.groups[groupId].controller;local a=c.world.actors[slot]
  a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(150,3,-5)+c.world.offset));a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 elseif action=='damage' then
  local c=controller.groups[groupId].controller;c.current:_hit(-1,slot,'Dash')
 elseif action=='bridge' then
  local c=controller.groups[groupId].controller
  c.director:_enterZone(6)
 end
 return game.HttpService:JSONEncode(result)
end
